import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 7))
sns.boxplot(x='sensor_type', y='price_usd', hue='body_type', data=df)

plt.ylabel('Price (USD)', labelpad=10)
plt.yscale('log')
plt.legend(title='Body Type', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
